choose.when: ORDER BY LOWER(s.source_name) ASC, s.id ASC
ORDER BY LOWER(s.source_name) DESC, s.id DESC
ORDER BY s.source_type ASC, s.id ASC
ORDER BY s.source_type DESC, s.id DESC
ORDER BY s.verification_status ASC, s.id ASC
ORDER BY s.verification_status DESC, s.id DESC
ORDER BY s.privacy_level ASC, s.id ASC
ORDER BY s.privacy_level DESC, s.id DESC
ORDER BY s.created_at ASC NULLS LAST, s.id ASC
ORDER BY s.created_at DESC NULLS LAST, s.id DESC
ORDER BY s.updated_at ASC NULLS LAST, s.id ASC
choose.otherwise: ORDER BY s.updated_at DESC NULLS LAST, s.id DESC

mapper.select: SELECT source_type AS sourceType, COUNT(*) AS count FROM source WHERE clan_id = #{clanId} GROUP BY source_type
SELECT * FROM source WHERE clan_id = #{clanId} ORDER BY updated_at DESC NULLS LAST, created_at DESC NULLS LAST, id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM source_attachment WHERE source_id = #{sourceId} AND deleted_at IS NULL
